mechanism: Modafinil induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing glipizide metabolism and reducing its hypoglycemic effect; modafinil may also have sympathomimetic properties that could counteract insulin secretion.
action: Monitor blood glucose levels closely and adjust glipizide dosing as needed; counsel patient on hypoglycemia awareness; consider alternative wakefulness-promoting agent if glycemic control becomes problematic.
